provenance: Hand-built. The coded rows are drug names in the form PRESCRIPTIONS.DRUG records them - generic name, often with a salt form. No MIMIC-III record contributed to this file; every string is a public generic or brand drug name. The extracted strings are how a drug is named in conversation: brand names, doses, and routes. Cases marked 'known-hard' are expected to fail.
